items.description: Local path to a PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP file. Relative paths resolve from the scene JSON directory.

character_description.description: ASCII English face description. Required and non-empty for include/hybrid modes; may be empty for reference_only.

face_reference_id.description: Optional single face reference path from reference_images; mutually exclusive with face_reference_ids.

face_reference_ids.description: Optional 1–3 face-reference paths from reference_images, attached before supporting references.

face_description_mode.description: hybrid uses a short face description as supporting traits; reference_only relies on the supplied images.

expression.description: Optional ASCII English expression/eye-state instruction applied near the end of the composed prompt.
